You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0054.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

cat > /tmp/build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
rw=Chem.RWMol()
def atom(sym, charge=0):
 a=Chem.Atom(sym); a.SetFormalCharge(charge); return rw.AddAtom(a)
def bond(i,j,t=Chem.BondType.SINGLE): rw.AddBond(i,j,t)
# Co center
Co=atom('Co')
B=atom('B',-1)
Hbor=atom('H'); bond(B,Hbor)
# three pyrazole rings. Nco-Nb-C5-C4-C3-Nco; C3 has tBu
ringdata=[]
for k in range(3):
 nco=atom('N'); nb=atom('N')
 c5=atom('C'); c4=atom('C'); c3=atom('C')
 bond(nco,nb); bond(nb,c5); bond(c5,c4,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond(c4,c3); bond(c3,nco,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
 # B-N connection, and dative Co donor
 bond(nb,B)
 bond(nco,Co,Chem.BondType.DATIVE)
 # tertbutyl at C3
 ct=atom('C'); bond(c3,ct)
 for q in range(3):
  cm=atom('C'); bond(ct,cm)
 ringdata.append((nco,nb,c5,c4,c3,ct))
# Axial organoiodine O donor ligand
Oco=atom('O'); I=atom('I'); bond(Oco,I); bond(Oco,Co,Chem.BondType.DATIVE)
# aryl six-ring adjacent I and S
ar=[atom('C') for _ in range(6)]
for i in range(6): bond(ar[i],ar[(i+1)%6], Chem.BondType.DOUBLE if i%2==0 else Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
bond(I,ar[0])
# tBuSO2 bonded at adjacent aryl carbon
S=atom('S'); bond(S,ar[1]);
# tertbutyl on sulfur
st=atom('C'); bond(S,st)
for q in range(3):
 cm=atom('C'); bond(st,cm)
for _ in range(2):
 o=atom('O'); bond(S,o,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
Oiod=atom('O'); bond(S,Oiod)
bond(Oiod,I)

m=rw.GetMol()
try:
 Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
 print('sanitized',m.GetNumAtoms())
except Exception as e:
 print('sanitize error',e); raise
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
print('atoms',m.GetNumAtoms())
params=AllChem.ETK DGv3 = None
PY

params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=42; params.maxIterations=1000
res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params)
print('embed',res)
if res<0: raise SystemExit('failed')
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m, maxIters=500)
conf=m.GetConformer()
with open('start.xyz','w') as f:

print('wrote start')

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
rw=Chem.RWMol()
def atom(sym, charge=0):
 a=Chem.Atom(sym); a.SetFormalCharge(charge); return rw.AddAtom(a)
def bond(i,j,t=Chem.BondType.SINGLE): rw.AddBond(i,j,t)
Co=atom('Co'); B=atom('B',-1); Hbor=atom('H'); bond(B,Hbor)
for k in range(3):
 nco=atom('N'); nb=atom('N'); c5=atom('C'); c4=atom('C'); c3=atom('C')
 bond(nco,nb); bond(nb,c5); bond(c5,c4,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond(c4,c3); bond(c3,nco,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE); bond(nb,B); bond(nco,Co,Chem.BondType.DATIVE)
 ct=atom('C'); bond(c3,ct)
 for q in range(3):
  cm=atom('C'); bond(ct,cm)
Oco=atom('O'); I=atom('I'); bond(Oco,I); bond(Oco,Co,Chem.BondType.DATIVE)
ar=[atom('C') for _ in range(6)]
for i in range(6): bond(ar[i],ar[(i+1)%6],Chem.BondType.DOUBLE if i%2==0 else Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
bond(I,ar[0]); S=atom('S'); bond(S,ar[1]); st=atom('C'); bond(S,st)
for q in range(3):
 cm=atom('C'); bond(st,cm)
for _ in range(2):
 o=atom('O'); bond(S,o,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
Oiod=atom('O'); bond(S,Oiod); bond(Oiod,I)
m=rw.GetMol()
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
print('Atoms',m.GetNumAtoms())
p=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); p.randomSeed=1154; p.maxIterations=2000
res=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,p); print('embed',res)
if res<0: raise RuntimeError('embedding failure')
# MMFF may not cover this system, use just for initial coordinates if supported
try:
 props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m)
 print('props',bool(props))
 if props: print('mmff',AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m,maxIters=1000))
except Exception as e: print('MMFF skip',e)
conf=m.GetConformer()
with open('init0054.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\nInitial embedded geometry\n')
 for a in m.GetAtoms():
  v=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx()); f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {v.x:.8f} {v.y:.8f} {v.z:.8f}\n')
